lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gills, organized into approximately six vertical columns and five horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs, creating a series of coordinate-like anchor nodes across the visible flank surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity light reflection on the superior edge and lower-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish silhouettes (remoras) clustered around the ventral-lateral region and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
